Resolves #3935

TextField and TextArea can show a live `0 / 200` counter beneath the input's right edge with `showCharacterCount: true`. It follows the text the user sees, including spaces while typing, and updates on blur, paste, clear/reset, programmatic values and limit changes. Both public field examples expose the option.

Evidence: L3 (real Chromium input, geometry and public-example checks, plus inspected screenshots) → L3 required for the visible field behavior. No residuals.

## AC Evidence

No structured ACs on #3935. The original TextField/TextArea count-and-limit request and the [intake contract](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/3935#issuecomment-6656796459) are covered by `test/playwright/component/form/field/Text.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/unit/form/field/TextCharacterCount.spec.mjs`: live text, input-write/caret stability, reset policy, all five label positions, errors, dynamic limits, accessible descriptions, and auto-growing text areas.

## Deltas from ticket

The new reactive option defaults to false. Without `maxLength`, it shows the current length alone; with a limit, it uses the existing validation's UTF-16 string-length convention. The `characterCountText({length, maxLength})` formatter lets applications localize the visible and accessible wording. Counter and errors occupy separate rows, and the input references the counter without replacing consumer-owned description IDs. TextArea inherits the behavior from Text. Existing input normalization and max-length enforcement remain authoritative. No consumer workaround is removed; this adds the requested capability.

## Test Evidence

The public text and textarea examples were rendered and inspected in Chromium; their visible checkbox labels toggle the counter. Captures are generated by the component spec. The initial focused browser arm failed because no counter existed; implementation passes the behavioral checks without weakening them. The layout probe identified the harness's implicit full-height `flex: 1`; form-placement cases explicitly use natural-sized fields. Unit and component coverage runs in CI.

`agent-preflight` is not hosted in this Engine checkout. PR-body, source hooks, diff and file-size checks were run directly.

## Post-Merge Validation

None required beyond the verified field behavior. Existing applications opt in through the new config.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge**: The counter is also the input's accessible description (`aria-describedby` → `${id}__character-count`), so a screen reader announces it as written, "12 / 200". A hardcoded format leaves apps no way to phrase it for their language or their assistive-tech users ("12 of 200 characters"). That's RA-1.

**Documented search**: *"I actively looked for (1) vdom index shifts from the new node (it's appended last, so `vdom.cn[1]`, the sublabel, keeps its index), (2) a `grid-area: sublabel` without a matching template area outside `label-top` (the sublabel only renders for `labelPosition: 'top'`, Text.mjs:600, so no implicit tracks), and (3) the counter writing back into the input (`syncCharacterCount()` only touches the counter node and the description list) and found no concerns."*
